messages:
Maria G: Heads up — we're coordinating with NorthCloud and SlateSI on a marketplace private-offer that bundles reserved capacity + hardware credits. Need to align structure for: committed spend floors, incremental discounts at renewal, and SI enablement kickers. Thoughts?
Alex (partnerships): Love the bundle idea. Proposal sketch: 1) 12m reserved commit (spend) + optional hardware credit 2) Renewal bands at 80/100/120% (discount delta -5/-10/-15 pp) 3) SI onboarding credit that vests over first 3 months so partners actually deploy. Can share calc sheet.
Maria G: @Alex can you add the customer-facing SKU names? Legal will want clear entitlements.
Samir P: Are we planning private offers only in AWS marketplace or also Azure/GCP? Different marketplaces have distinta private-offer mechanics — need to know before we lock commit terms.
Alex (partnerships): Start with AWS + Marketplace private offer for initial launch, but design contract clauses to be portable to Azure later (metering differences, SKU names). We'll use a generic "Reserved Compute Credits" SKU that maps per-cloud.
Ben (Legal): Make sure renewal language includes: a) baseline committed spend recalculation window (30d before term) b) unused credit escrow/rollover rules (max 10% carryover) c) entitlements for SI credits (non-transferable). I'll draft template clauses. Also check export/compliance for hardware credits.
Tia - Sales: Sales comp concerns — if SI credit vests, reps need to still get quota credit. Propose a 30% immediate booking credit, rest on deploy milestones. Also want a one-pager we can pitch to existing enterprise customers.
MarketplaceBot: Automated notice: AWS Private Offers require acceptance within 14 days. Link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/private-offers
Alex (partnerships): Action items: @Ben to draft legal clauses by EOD Wed; @Tia to prepare one-pager and incentive proposal; @Samir to confirm target clouds + any marketplace constraints; I'll produce a pricing calc and example SKU mapping. Meeting Friday 10am to finalize.
Maria G: Perfect. Quick win: if we attach a short SI enablement checklist to the offer, partners feel safer to commit. +1 on vesting credits. :thumbsup:
Ben (Legal): Noted. I'll include SI checklist pointers and a suggested clawback schedule in the draft.
Tia - Sales: I'll loop in SEA sales lead for APAC localization once we have the draft.
Alex (partnerships): Thanks team — I'll drop the calc and draft SKU mapping into the partnership folder and ping when ready.
